prices = {
    "Oko, Thief of Crowns": [25.0, 35.0, 41.0, 45.0, 38.0, 28.0, 19.0, 16.0],
    "Once Upon a Time": [12.0, 18.0, 22.0, 37.0, 31.0, 12.0, 3.0, 1.5],
    "Veil of Summer": [8.0, 11.0, 14.0, 16.0, 12.0, 9.0, 5.0, 6.0],
}

for card, series in prices.items():
    high = max(series)
    low = min(series)
    drop = high - low
    print(f"{card}: High=${high:.2f}, Low=${low:.2f}, Drop=${drop:.2f}")
